nodes.text: Wait, Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What's up, Julia?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: My name's not... Forget that. If Jane isn't the new, popular girl you're talking about...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...Who is?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You don't know? It's Kimi. Kimi Chen.
Maria gasps.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Kimi's... Popular?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Because of a stupid party?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Stupid?! Party?! I've never heard those two words next to each other!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It was nice to have another athlete on the team...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But you're off the team, Jane. You're too... Uh...
Jane's nostrils flare.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...Too strong a woman?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I get it.
Jane storms off.
The other girls look at Maria, expecting her to kick Jane off the team then and there!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What? Jane made an honest mistake.
Jane sits back down.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Way to go, Jane! Now we'll never get invited to any parties!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: There goes my social life!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh, relax. It's not that bad.
In the not so distant future...
The cheerleaders are walking down the hall, careful to stay close to the edges, hugging the wall, trying to stay invisible...
Keith stumbles...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Oof!
...And accidentally grazes a basketball player's arm! Everyone gasps!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What is the meaning of this?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I didn't mean anything by it! Honest! I swear! I just tripped!
Andy snaps his fingers!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: No! Please! No!
Zach and Spencer rush to the scene.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: This... `Cheerleader` touched my arm. `Aggressively!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cheerleader[/i][/color] touched my arm. [color=#e23b3b][i]Aggressively![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Disgusting!
Zach talks into a small mic in his hand.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Prepare the detention chamber.
Maria steps forward!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It wasn't like that.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Make that two chambers.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No! Look! This is madness! When did it get like this?!
Everyone in the hallway has stopped and is looking at Maria!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I remember a time when cheerleaders were at the `top` of the social ladder!
nodes.text_bbcode: I remember a time when cheerleaders were at the [color=#3b78e2][i]top[/i][/color] of the social ladder!

nodes.text: Someone laughs.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's true! I was there! I remember a time when we didn't have to hide who we were!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come along, cheerleader. You're only making things worse!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Actually, I remember the exact moment when it changed...
Maria glances at Jane.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sorry, but I stand by my beliefs.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Your beliefs destroyed us... Your beliefs destroyed all that was great.
As Zach and Spencer haul Keith and Maria away, it's `VERY` apparent that...
nodes.text_bbcode: As Zach and Spencer haul Keith and Maria away, it's [b]VERY[/b] apparent that...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: The good news is... Jane, you're doing really well! Turns out swimmers make for good cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yay. Just what I wanted... To have my beauty reaffirmed by a societal group that values short skirts over intellect.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Maybe `I` should go into swimming...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] should go into swimming...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You're already on the team, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I am? Past me is `so` smart!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am? Past me is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] smart!

nodes.text: During the second half of lunch...
The team scrambles about for food and finds seats at the Center Table. At a nearby table, Cameron is talking to Zach.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Guys, shh! Shh!
The cheerleaders quiet down and casually eavesdrop.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You think I should invite her?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Dude! Anyone who gets so cool `and` popular that quick is a must-invite!
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude! Anyone who gets so cool [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] popular that quick is a must-invite!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess she really has proven herself. Okay, I'll do it.
Cameron gets up and heads in the general direction of their table. Before he can say anything, Jane stands, outraged! She points an accusatory finger at Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: That's all it takes, huh?! All it takes for me to get invited to a party?!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Just join an elitist group that spreads the objectification of women!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem! Women?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Not `now,` Hector!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]now,[/i][/color] Hector!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, I'm sorry! If I don't get an invitation for being a part of the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: There's no reason I should get one `the day` after I join the cheerleading team!
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no reason I should get one [color=#3b78e2][i]the day[/i][/color] after I join the cheerleading team!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You done?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm done!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I wasn't talking about you.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You, uh, you weren't?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No. You `were` invited to the party.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. You [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] invited to the party.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I was? Wait, why 'were'?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Because we don't want to invite people who are as hot-tempered as you.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're no fun. In fact, it kind of seems like the cheerleaders are no fun.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So maybe we won't be extending any of you invitations!
The cheerleaders gasp!

options.label: Let it slide and keep her on the team!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm sorry, too, Ashley. You made some ground with the football team for us...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But we can't have someone on the team if they're a hazard to everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I could wear an orange cone...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're off the team, Ashley. You're too klutzy.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I figured...
Ashley sulks off.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's... Okay. We'll just have to work on your coordination. A lot.
Three weeks later...
Maria limps to the front of the cheerleading team...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All right. Let me hear the latest injury report. Jill? How's your knee?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Still hurts! It'd be fine if it weren't for the clumsy rhino on our team!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'm really sorry...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Let's just get through this, okay? Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Still having trouble walking.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I feel great!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Amanda, your arm is in a cast!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Besides that I mean!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Keith?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Doctor said another three weeks...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Really sorry...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Nicole? Lindsay?
Maria looks up. Neither Nicole or Lindsay are there. All the cheerleaders have their heads bowed.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh, right...
As Maria surveys what remains of her battered squad, it's pretty clear...
During the first half of lunch...
The cheerleaders meet out on the football field.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Do we really have to meet during lunch? I'm `so` hungry!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do we really have to meet during lunch? I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] hungry!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Suck it up, Keith!
Jill's stomach rumbles.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And suck it up, me...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm sorry, everyone. But this is the only way we can practice out here, and this is where the end-of-the-year rally's going to be.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: At least it'll give us a chance to see more of Ashley and Jane's moves.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Why don't we incorporate Ashley and Jane into the salsa that happens right before Nicole and I get lifted up?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Salsa? Like the food?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Like, the dance?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I don't know how to salsa.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Really? It's not hard. Just three steps in a four-beat measure.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Uh... I'll just follow someone's lead.
The music starts... Two steps into the dance, and Ashley dances right into Keith, knocking him over!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Let's try again!
The music starts again... A few beats in, and Ashley trips over her own feet, taking Jill down with her!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Whoops! Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's okay! Let's try to stay on our feet!
The music starts once more... After just a few beats, Ashley spins and slams her elbow into Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ow! Pointy!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry!

options.label: Tell her it's okay and keep her on the team!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's it! You're off the squad!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You're... You're kicking me off?! But... But I've only been a cheerleader for `one` day!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're... You're kicking me off?! But... But I've only been a cheerleader for [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] day!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And that was probably one day too long.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Anyway, you're off the team, Ryan. You're too gross.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I've heard that before too.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ryan! You're out of line!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh, I'm just getting started!
With Ryan staying on the team, things go from bad...
To `worse!`
nodes.text_bbcode: To [b]worse![/b]

nodes.text: After practice, the girls step into the locker room...
Only to find Ryan standing in front of a mirror, wearing nothing but a small towel!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaah! Ugly guy in the locker room! Avert your eyes!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Ryan?! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Airing out! Something wrong?
Maria quickly pulls Ryan back toward the door!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Get out! You know very well that you belong in the `guys'` locker room!
nodes.text_bbcode: Get out! You know very well that you belong in the [color=#3b78e2][i]guys'[/i][/color] locker room!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: This is sexism! I demand a lawyer... Or more locker room time!
Maria manages to shove him out, shutting the door! Looking down, she sees that she's now holding Ryan's towel...
Shrieks echo in the hall!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh oh!
When Maria turns around, the cheerleaders are all glaring at her.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I know, I know. This is `the` worst decision I've ever made in my life!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, I know. This is [color=#3b78e2][i]the[/i][/color] worst decision I've ever made in my life!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, one that you made without us! We quit!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What? You can't quit! I'll just throw Ryan off the team!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You should have thought of that earlier! We're tired of dealing with that sleaze!
All the cheerleaders march past Maria and out of the locker room!
And Maria knows...
Maria shrugs it off.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Anyway, as I was saying before... It's time for tryouts!
In the gym after school...
The cheerleaders sit at a long table. A line of students snakes out of the door underneath a sign that says, 'Tryouts'.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Listen up! First you're going to introduce yourself, then you're going to dance for us! Let's go!
The tryouts begin!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: My name's Hannah. I love motorcycles, drama, and secret tattoos.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Great! And what dance are you going to be doing today?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: By myself?! Ugh! I only dance with guys!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Next!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh! Hi there! I don't know if you remember, but `technically,` I'm on the team still!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh! Hi there! I don't know if you remember, but [color=#e23b3b][i]technically,[/i][/color] I'm on the team still!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Still?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Funny mix-up! See, I was the mascot...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...And then you stopped inviting me to events.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh... We'll keep you on call if we need any more mascot stuff.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yippee!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Next!

nodes.speaker: Doug
nodes.text: Sup.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Next!
A student no one has ever seen before walks to the center of the floor and starts doing a chicken dance.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Next!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Heh. Hey, laaaaadies! I'm Ryan, I like, uh, laaaaadies. Heh.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You must be joking! Next!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Wait! I'm serious!
Maria crosses her arms.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're serious? You actually want to be a cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Want `to be` a cheerleader? `Want` a cheerleader? Close enough, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Want [color=#e23b3b][i]to be[/i][/color] a cheerleader? [color=#e23b3b][i]Want[/i][/color] a cheerleader? Close enough, right?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Next!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, I thought we were discussing!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It doesn't matter anyway because you have to be able to dance to--
Ryan snaps his fingers! Music plays over the gym's speakers!
He gyrates and twists to the beat, his body fluid, his moves crisp all the way to the song's end.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I think I can speak for everyone here when I say, `'What.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think I can speak for everyone here when I say, [color=#3b78e2][i]'What.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So? Am I on the team?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Cheerleaders, huddle up!
The cheerleaders huddle up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: There's no way we can take Ryan, right?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: His moves were good.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: But he's `such` a creeper.
nodes.text_bbcode: But he's [color=#3b78e2][i]such[/i][/color] a creeper.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: He literally sprayed all of us with water yesterday. I had to re-gel. And I `hate` re-gelling!
nodes.text_bbcode: He literally sprayed all of us with water yesterday. I had to re-gel. And I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] re-gelling!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He's the water guy? Then I like him!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We want someone people know. People `know` Ryan.
nodes.text_bbcode: We want someone people know. People [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And his connections to the rebels might actually re-create the same peace treaty we had when $ZOE was around.
Maria ends the huddle.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm about to say this, but you're on.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Heh. Sweet! I can't wait to lift all of you.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Already regretting! Just take a seat over there, will you?!
By the end of the day, Maria adds two more cheerleader candidates to the mix, Ashley and Jane.
All three candidates stand in front of the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ashley, we were impressed by your positive attitude during your tryout.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Thanks! I'm so happy to be here!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And Jane, we really loved your athletic prowess.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I'm just here to prove that a strong, independent, proud woman can easily compete in roles typically filled by vacuous--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whatever. All three of you are on probation. That means if you slip up, you're off the team.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yo!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You are on, like, super mega ultra probation. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, the judge said the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just behave.
In geometry class the next day, Zach sees Ashley's new uniform.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, nerd girl, when did you become a cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Yesterday! And my name's Ashley!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Can you make cupcakes?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No, but I `can` help you out with your homework!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]can[/i][/color] help you out with your homework!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You mean it? 'Cause that's almost as good as $ZOE's cupcakes!
In the back of the class, Maria smiles at Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Looks like our plan's already working!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah! Who needs $ZOE?!
Ryan plops down in between them.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You mean... Who needs $ZOE when the Ry-guy is right here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Tell me yesterday you weren't moved by my moves, hypnotized by my hips, and grooved by my groove thing!
Maria and Nicole scowl.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Awww, yeah! I knew it! Soon, you'll all be Ry-Guy Girls... If you know what I mean.

options.label: Admonish him but keep him on the team!

nodes.text: Maria doesn't say anything more. Nicole and Lindsay aren't quite sure what to do.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, anyway...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Should I have stuck up for Kimi more? It's not like we're friends now...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Emphasis on `used to.` You're both totally right!
nodes.text_bbcode: Emphasis on [color=#3b78e2][i]used to.[/i][/color] You're both totally right!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This video is `so` embarrassing! What's with that outfit?!
nodes.text_bbcode: This video is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] embarrassing! What's with that outfit?!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ha! Seriously!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Totally!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay... Now I feel... Bad.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE? But she didn't have enough time for practice.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I know, but having her on the team goes a `long` way!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, but having her on the team goes a [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] way!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We could practice on the field, we could get invited to parties, and--

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Shock. What do the rest of you think?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE's cool.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, I `love` $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I guess it wouldn't hurt that much to `say` she's on the team.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess it wouldn't hurt that much to [color=#e23b3b][i]say[/i][/color] she's on the team.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: As long as she doesn't get any perks for doing nothing...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All right! It's settled! I'll go let $ZOE know right now!
A few minutes later, in front of the school...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Maria! How's cheerleading going?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's what I wanted to talk to you about! How would you feel about rejoining the squad?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd... I'd love to, but--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But what? I thought you'd jump at the chance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing's changed, Maria! I... I don't have the time to be Social Chair and do cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And right now, being Social Chair is more important to me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But something has changed, $ZOE! You don't have to do anything!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You don't have to even cheer! We just need you for your reputation!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You want me to be on the cheerleading team, even though I won't be able to do any cheering?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yup! And you can take credit for it with the Kingston rep! Everyone wins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Except me!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Did you not hear me? Kingston rep?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'll be getting credit for something I'm not even doing!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, that's not how I operate!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I can't believe this! The only thing keeping me from solving all our problems is your silly moral integrity.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm afraid so!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Fine! Enjoy your sense of superiority!
Maria storms off!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What a goodie-goodie!
But as she heads back to the cheerleaders, she knows $ZOE is in the right, and she is in the wrong.
She knows...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: OMG! Can we finally get a replacement for $ZOE?! It's been forever!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's been, like, a week.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But enough about that! We need someone to fill the void $ZOE left behind.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Someone people know, someone kind-hearted the same way $ZOE is, someone who can do a toe-touch when we ask her to.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem. Her?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Really? Are we going to deal with gender `every` time.
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? Are we going to deal with gender [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] time.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just saying.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Fine. Toe-touch. Him, her, whatever.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: The point is... It's time for tryouts! And they start right--

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We `always` practice in the spring!
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] practice in the spring!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Gotta get that early start! STATE, baby, STATE!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's a lie! I've been here as long as all of you, and I've `never` seen you practicing in the spring!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's a lie! I've been here as long as all of you, and I've [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] seen you practicing in the spring!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we've never gone this long without our football cupcakes either.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Football cupcakes? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like you don't know!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Green paper bag? Football-frosted cupcakes?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And a special note that makes you feel good inside...
Realization dawns on Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE! She gave you those!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We changed our practice time to way too early in the morning for those cupcakes. Now that the cupcakes have stopped coming...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We practice `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We practice [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We can make you guys cupcakes! That's not that hard!
Zach scoffs!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We're not talking about just any old cupcakes from the store! We're talking about $ZOE cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: She's... A cupcake angel.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Truth.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So what? Just because you guys aren't getting your sugar fix, you're going to ruin our practice?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That is exactly it!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Fine! Cheerleaders, we're moving out! Let's `go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! Cheerleaders, we're moving out! Let's [color=#3b78e2][i]go![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `FIGHT!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]FIGHT![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not now, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Somewhere quiet where I can host my first `cheermergency!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Somewhere quiet where I can host my first [color=#3b78e2][i]cheermergency![/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the library...
The cheerleaders bicker over the issue with the football players.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: They're idiots. I say we just practice on the field right next to them! And if one of them comes near me... Well, I'll kick him where there is no padding!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I wouldn't mind getting close to them. Spencer's kind of cute.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Nicole! They're the enemy right now!
Nicole scowls.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I don't understand why we don't just bake our own stupid cupcakes for them.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: It's not like $ZOE's cupcakes taste like miracles.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Have you tried them?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Then shut up.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: FYI, they're miraculously delicious.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Anyone else have any bright ideas?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We could throw a slammin' party! Football players and cheerleaders! Together at last again!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Parties are great, but this is not the time for one.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I. Don't. What?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! I know! We could `become` football players!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh! I know! We could [color=#3b78e2][i]become[/i][/color] football players!

nodes.text: Maria sighs. At a nearby table, the nerds are chuckling over a music video on the internet.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: The problem we're having is bigger than just this incident with the football players.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Even if $ZOE wasn't coming to most of our practices, I'm afraid she did a lot more for us than I realized...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `Everyone` knows $ZOE...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Everyone[/i][/color] knows $ZOE...

nodes.text: Earlier that week...
Nicole and Maria corner Cameron at his locker.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hi, Cam.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hi... Cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I heard the guys on the swim team are throwing a party this weekend...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You heard correct.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well? Invite?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It's not my place to invite girls I don't even know.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You... You don't know our names?
Cameron looks at Maria.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Julia?
Maria shakes her head. Cameron looks at Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Coco?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Really? Coco?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Second. She was keeping peace with groups we haven't always gotten along with...
Yesterday, in the parking lot...
The cheerleaders are walking toward their cars when--
Ryan, Megan, and Kenji come squealing by in a massive pickup truck!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Water cannon!
Ryan fires a gigantic water cannon from the back of the truck!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Aaaah! Duck!
The cheerleaders are instantly drenched!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: This is the worst!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `love` water!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] water!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And I love seeing you all like this!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Have a nice ride home, cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sorry if we ruined your expensive clothes! And your primped hair! And your perfect makeup!
The truck roars off!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And third. $ZOE was... Better at following directions than...
Maria casts a glance at Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Than others.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know that look! It means we're going shopping soon! Right?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So what are you saying then?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm saying... I think we need to...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Rude, obnoxious, football idiots!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Not only are you distracting my girls--

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: My `team` from getting our routine right, you're also endangering them!
nodes.text_bbcode: My [color=#3b78e2][i]team[/i][/color] from getting our routine right, you're also endangering them!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Is Keith's butt injury a season-ender or what?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Shut up, Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Make me!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey! You may not realize this, but the rise in catastrophic cheerleading injuries is a big deal!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Catastrophic injuries? Don't you just spell stuff with your hands?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's a little more complicated than that! The point is... Stop endangering my team!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We're sorry about that...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe we were out of line.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't care! I just want to know `why` are you practicing? Football doesn't start again until next season!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't care! I just want to know [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] are you practicing? Football doesn't start again until next season!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Uh... Uh, yeah, that's true! We are!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And you're in our way!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're in `our` way! We were here first!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're in [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] way! We were here first!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! This is `our` field!
nodes.text_bbcode: It doesn't matter! This is [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] field!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah! It's the football field! Not the cheerleading field!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well... Well...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Face it. You just got burned.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I did not!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah-huh. You got so burned you need a lifetime supply of aloe.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whatever. Why are you even practicing? Football doesn't start again until next season!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Uh oh!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We're going down!
The pyramid twists, and soon everyone is off-balance! At the bottom, Lindsay buckles under the pressure!
The whole thing topples over!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaah! Oof!
The cheerleaders are tangled up in a messy pile of legs, arms, and hair. Nearby, the football players double over with laughter!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hahaha! Funniest thing I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I saw it too!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's it! No one interrupts `my` practice!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! No one interrupts [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] practice!

nodes.text: Maria rises and marches over to the football players!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What does it look like we're doing?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It looks like you're...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hold it! Hold the pyramid! Don't pay attention to them!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just `focus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just [color=#3b78e2][i]focus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: For one second, it looks like the pyramid is going to fall over...
But steeled by Maria's voice, the cheerleaders right the pyramid!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yes! We did it!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Aww, man! I really wanted to see a cheerleader haystack!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's it! Disassemble the cheeramid! No one interrupts `my` practice!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! Disassemble the cheeramid! No one interrupts [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] practice!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders disassemble the pyramid. Maria hops down and marches over to the football players!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hector, focus!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, 'butt' is a funny word!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Two more seconds! We can do this!
The pyramid wobbles, then steadies...
But Zach and Jacob start playing catch with each other `over` the pyramid!
nodes.text_bbcode: But Zach and Jacob start playing catch with each other [b]over[/b] the pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hahaha! This is funny because `we` thought of it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hahaha! This is funny because [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] thought of it!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Finally! Cheerleaders actually serving a purpose!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Wha?! Did he just say what I think he did?! Because if he did, he is going to--
The pyramid teeters to one side!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh oh! We're gonna fall!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's nothing! Stay focused! We can hold this for at `least` five more seconds!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's nothing! Stay focused! We can hold this for at [color=#3b78e2][i]least[/i][/color] five more seconds!

nodes.text: The pyramid steadies itself...
Maria sneaks a glance behind her... Some of the football players are running around on the field!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What the--?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, Jacob! Go long!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Is that the football team?! Why are they here? It's spring!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is `our` field in the spring!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] field in the spring!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Is everyone forgetting that I just got hit?! By a football?! In the butt?!
Hector starts laughing. The pyramid wobbles even more!
Maria mimics Kimi's wacky dance, squatting, jumping, and shimmying...
Soon, the whole cheerleading team is following along...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We look stupid!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I've never been more mortified!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee hee! I `like` doing The Kimi!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee hee! I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] doing The Kimi!

nodes.text: But soon, the crowd is clapping, cheering, and even mimicking Kimi's wacky dance!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I knew it! It doesn't matter what Kimi does!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: When you're this popular, whatever you do `becomes` popular!
nodes.text_bbcode: When you're this popular, whatever you do [color=#3b78e2][i]becomes[/i][/color] popular!

nodes.text: After practice, the crowd disperses...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Awesome practice, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maria, can I talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, great dance, by the way!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No sweat! Thanks for playing, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Mwah!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey SHS Fans! It's me, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Want to see how I became crazy popular so quickly? Want to see how the cheerleaders treated me at the mall? Want to see more of me and Kevin?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then check out the next Surviving High School novel, `How to Be a Star` by M. Doty!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then check out the next Surviving High School novel, [color=#3b78e2][i]How to Be a Star[/i][/color] by M. Doty!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Finally, it's my turn to be in the spotlight... Literally!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The novel is available wherever popular books are sold `and` is also available in digital form!
nodes.text_bbcode: The novel is available wherever popular books are sold [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] is also available in digital form!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If you're interested, you can order it right now!

nodes.prompt: Do you want to check out the `How to Be a Star` novel in iTunes?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you want to check out the `How to Be a Star` novel in iTunes?

nodes.text: Maria starts to imitate Kimi, but she can feel herself getting more and more embarrassed!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Psst! Just do one of our routines!
While Kimi continues to do her wacky dance, the cheerleaders change course, dancing their own routine!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Much better!
But the crowd doesn't like it!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I like Kimi's dance!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, what are the rest of you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Boo!
Slowly the crowd dissipates, angry that the cheerleaders aren't copying Kimi!
Later, after practice...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Everyone, sorry that didn't go how we wanted it to...
The girls grumble their dissatisfaction.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maria, can I talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, Kimi. I'm sorry to you too for not following along. Your dance was actually pretty great!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We're just not used to dancing how you do.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's okay...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't feel like a star...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's because most people work really `really` hard to become popular.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's because most people work really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] hard to become popular.

nodes.text: Maria takes a deep breath, contemplating something. Then...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But you did it overnight! You're golden now!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks! I think I needed to hear that from someone who isn't my little sister.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How's Lily?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Still playing. She's adorable. She's at that age where every dress she tries on looks perfect on her.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I miss that age.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Me too.
Maria laughs suddenly.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did I say something funny?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, for some reason I was thinking about Amanda's pool party, back in middle school...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The one with the pinata?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, remember when it was Amanda's turn to break it open?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ha! She wouldn't hit it because the pinata looked like a pony!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I just remember her looking crazy worried and saying, 'I don't want candy `this` much!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I just remember her looking crazy worried and saying, 'I don't want candy [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] much!`

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Haha! I had totally forgotten about that!
The girls' laughter subsides.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But, uh, that's not what I remember most about that party...
Kimi goes quiet...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're talking about when I fell?
Maria nods.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I just remember I fell and hit my lip on the side of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It was pretty scary. Do you remember who pulled you out?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, I remember getting rushed to the emergency room, but I--
Kimi stops when she sees the look on Maria's face.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You?
Maria nods.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I know we're not as close as we used to be, but you're with me now.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And if you fall, I'm going to be there to pick you up.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awww! Thanks, Maria!
Kimi leans across and gives Maria a hug. She starts to get out of Maria's car...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'll see you at practice!
Kimi smiles.
The next day, on the football field...
Maria and the cheerleaders get set up for practice. Around them, a crowd is slowly forming...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Listen up! Let's all welcome the newest cheerleader to join the team... `Kimi!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen up! Let's all welcome the newest cheerleader to join the team... [color=#3b78e2][i]Kimi![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yo, Kimi! Welcome to the squad!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah! `Way` better than Ryan!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! [color=#e23b3b][i]Way[/i][/color] better than Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ha! You guys haven't even seen me cheer yet!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Does `not` matter. Way better than Ryan. Trust me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Does [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] matter. Way better than Ryan. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm really excited to have another redhead on the team!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda, Kimi's hair isn't...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Isn't what?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nope. Never mind. It's, uh... Not as pretty as yours.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee! Thanks, Hecky!
Jill gives Kimi a slap on the back.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: `Loved` the video. I just hope the way you were dancing in it was a joke. It was, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Loved[/i][/color] the video. I just hope the way you were dancing in it was a joke. It was, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah-ha! A joke! Heh...
Meanwhile, Nicole and Lindsay pull Maria aside...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Did you hear that? She probably can't even dance!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: This is a `big` mistake, Maria!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is a [color=#3b78e2][i]big[/i][/color] mistake, Maria!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Is it?! Why don't you look around you, Lindsay?!
Maria sweeps her hand out at the huge crowd that has now formed around the field.
Some of the students are even holding up signs for Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's been a `long` time since we got this level of attention, if ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's been a [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] time since we got this level of attention, if ever!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Not to mention the fact that the football team is `in the crowd` and not on the field!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to mention the fact that the football team is [color=#3b78e2][i]in the crowd[/i][/color] and not on the field!

nodes.text: Near the front of the crowd, Zach, Jacob, and Spencer point out Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, well, if the freshman can't dance, we're about to be `super` embarrassed!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, if the freshman can't dance, we're about to be [color=#3b78e2][i]super[/i][/color] embarrassed!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just... Just follow my lead, okay?
Maria leaves Nicole and Lindsay, heading to her spot in the center of the field.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Listen up! Everyone, get into position!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um, Maria!
Kimi runs over to Maria...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What's up, Superstar?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What, exactly, is my position?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just dance out in front of us, and we'll follow your lead!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Really.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay!
Kimi takes a position in the very front, the rest of the cheerleading team behind her.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I hope my hunch is right about this. Otherwise the team will be an even bigger joke!
The music starts...
Kimi dances an awkward dance like the one in her video, alternating between a squat and a jump, and finishing with a shimmy of her shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Oh my--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Shut up, Jill! Just do what she does!

options: Do what you want to do!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I deserve to be on the team because I'm famous?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah! Everyone knows you now!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I get how that is the definition of famous, but I don't understand why that means I deserve to be on the team.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because it sounds like if people didn't know me, I wouldn't be offered a spot.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well... That's... Kinda true.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?! That's horrible!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just listen, okay? I know it sounds bad...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But people know you `because` of the video. And if the video wasn't any good, people wouldn't care.
nodes.text_bbcode: But people know you [color=#3b78e2][i]because[/i][/color] of the video. And if the video wasn't any good, people wouldn't care.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So, um... That's saying something, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I guess.

nodes.speaker: Maria

Jane pulls out her dangly earrings!
